Container.Name: hatchlight
Container.Overview: Make pictures with local and cloud AI models, for the people of your home, on your server's NVIDIA card. Accounts, a shared gallery each person keeps private, and LoRA training. Needs the Nvidia Driver plugin (driver 570 or newer). The first time, open the WebUI and enter the setup code from the container's log. The port is published on every address of the server: to reach it only through a reverse proxy, remove the port and put the container on the proxy's network, or give it its own address with a custom network (br0).
Container.ExtraParams: --runtime=nvidia --stop-timeout 30 --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --cap-drop ALL --cap-add CHOWN --cap-add DAC_OVERRIDE --cap-add FOWNER --cap-add SETUID --cap-add SETGID --cap-add SETPCAP
Container.Requires: The Nvidia Driver plugin, with an NVIDIA card and driver 570 or newer.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address people type in their browser, such as http://192.168.1.20:4096, or https://hatchlight.example.com behind a proxy.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Gallery, accounts, settings and saved keys. Back this up.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Local models and LoRAs: tens of GB. They download again if lost.

Config.Name: Trainer
Config.Description: The LoRA trainer's Python and PyTorch, installed on first use.

Config.Name: GPU
Config.Description: Which NVIDIA cards Hatchlight uses: all, or a card's UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin.

Config.Name: Other host names
Config.Description: Other names the server is reached by, comma-separated, such as tower.local.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Addresses of a reverse proxy in front of Hatchlight, whose X-Forwarded headers are believed. Leave empty without a proxy.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the files belong to (99 is nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the files belong to (100 is users on Unraid).
